scenarios.name: Severe Weather Alert
scenarios.description:
1. Find your state and then your county code http://alerts.weather.gov/#m     
2. Take that code and paste it to the end of this: http://alerts.weather.gov/cap/wwaatmget.php?x= 
3. Enter that string below in the "New feed item" window.

This will blink your lights in the event of a severe weather warning in your area whenever IFTTT updates - which is usually around every 15 minutes.
